bds.h: 4 key findings in the Jeffrey Epstein report from GOP-led House Oversight panel
bds.lede: Jeffrey Epstein’s crimes committed after 2005 could have been prevented, barring “repeated failures” from law enforcement and federal prosecutors. That’s one of the findings in a report published Tuesday by the House Oversight Committee after an investigation into the late convicted sex offender and his associates.
